description: Delete a registered price-change alert by its ID. Operator only: needs the server operator's key (MCP_API_KEY) on the MCP connection (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer); any other caller, including the chat agent and the local STDIO server, gets error_code operator_key_required. To remove an alert you registered, contact the operator.

alert_id.description: The ID of the alert to delete (from list_price_alerts or register_price_alert)

name: delete_price_alert
